note: Numbers are spelled out on purpose: the model reads digits inconsistently, and the verifier compares what it actually said against this script word for word. Nothing built from a participant's own run is in here — counts, remainders, clock readings and their own two words are all rendered on screen and left unspoken, because a voice reading someone their own numbers back turns a mirror into a report.

direction._: calm, warm, unhurried; one person speaking to one person in a quiet room
direction.enter: ordinary and practical, a colleague passing something on; no weight on the last line, it is help and not a rule
direction.workspace: plain and brief, then out of the way; nothing here should sound like an instruction about how much to check
direction.answer: light, almost conversational; the question a colleague asks over a desk
direction.reveal: quiet and level, straight after a pause; stating what happened, never marking it
direction.mirror: slow and steady, and completely without judgement; these two sentences are the point of the whole Pulse and they must not sound like a verdict
direction.ladder: even and unhurried; the same tone for all three, so the escalation comes from the stakes and not from the voice
direction.end: settled and warm, the way a thing is closed rather than concluded

en.enter-1: A client is waiting for an update.
en.enter-2: Can you confirm the current status of Plot A seventeen?
en.enter-3: You have a few places you can check.
en.enter-4: Answer when you think you know enough.
en.answer: So — what would you tell the client?
en.reveal-1: You didn't have the whole picture.
en.reveal-1-all: The six of them still didn't say the same thing.
en.reveal-2: But you decided you knew enough to answer.
en.mirror-1: Nobody told you when you knew enough.
en.ladder: The same thing you know right now.
en.end-1: You will rarely have the whole picture. And there will almost always be another source you could check.
en.end-2: At some point, you stop. Not because you know everything.
en.end-3: Because you decide you know enough for what happens next.

id.enter-2: Bisa konfirmasi status Plot A tujuh belas sekarang?
id.enter-3: Ada beberapa tempat yang bisa kamu cek.
id.enter-4: Jawab ketika kamu merasa sudah cukup tahu.
id.workspace: Buka apa pun yang kamu perlukan.
id.answer: Jadi — apa yang kamu sampaikan ke klien?
id.reveal-1-all: Keenamnya pun tetap tidak mengatakan hal yang sama.
id.reveal-2: Tapi kamu memutuskan sudah cukup tahu untuk menjawab.
id.mirror-1: Tidak ada yang memberi tahu kamu kapan kamu sudah cukup tahu.
id.ladder: Hal yang sama yang kamu tahu sekarang.
id.end-1: Kamu jarang akan punya gambaran utuhnya. Dan hampir selalu ada satu sumber lagi yang bisa dicek.
id.end-2: Pada satu titik, kamu berhenti. Bukan karena kamu tahu segalanya.
id.end-3: Tapi karena kamu memutuskan kamu cukup tahu untuk apa yang terjadi berikutnya.
